title: To investigate (owner, 2026-10-15): a handful of Reeds and small Nih-Dairia hunting the tank during the waves; a release rule gated on the frame rate; sinkholes as real slopes the tank can fall into
context: Owner, 2026-10-15, notes 11-13 on 244f3c9b: '11) if it is not too expensive for fps, let's introduce a handful of Reeds and small ni-dhaira once in a while during the waves, giving diversity. Non rammable, they actively try to hunt the tank, not too big, smaller in height than the height of the walls. 12) can we release waves of enemies with a logic keep releasing until <upper bound> UNLESS fps dips below 30, THEN stop and wait? Not urgent, file as to investigate. 13) in general; the way we deal with sinkholes and being close to sinkhole feels off, could we have them be a real slope? With a risk of the tank falling even?' What exists: (11) the Reed family runs in the story through the same seam as the Pearl set (src/fx/creature-reed.js, ?creatures=reed:<tier>; ENEMY_SPEC.reed rammable false, so a Reed already hurts to touch and shrugs the ram); a record steers by distToHeart at every cell (src/fx/enemy-step.js), nothing hunts the tank; the small tier is r0 2 m (4 m wide) against a wall of 0.03 planet radii (~3.6 m); the probe measured a Reed at ~0.6 ms a solver step at 240 Hz (2026-10-12-creature-enemies-pass-two-reeds), and the family is held to CREATURE_FAMILY.budget (10 ms a frame) past which every body's clock slows. (12) CROWD_CAP (src/content/sectors.js: start 1500, min 400, slowMs 36, fastMs 24, down 0.85, up 1.06 a second) already lowers the alive cap while frames run over 36 ms (28 fps) and raises it under 24 ms, and a flow sector's target is clamped by it (src/domain/sector-shape.js flowTarget, src/fx/crowd-gate.js); a pulse sector's breath is not. (13) The sinkhole is drawn as a cone (src/sinkhole.js) on a flat walkable surface; the hull may not drive onto a crater (src/game-breaches.js craters), bodies rise at the lip (EMERGENCE).
outcome: Filed, not built. (11) A first version would be a HUNTERS table (from sector, every n pulses, count, alive at most, family 'reed' tier 'small'), queue entries marked hunter through the wave hook (src/fx/creature-enemies.js replace), and a hunt field: bfsDist from the tank's cell (player.cur) once a second while a hunter lives, the hunter's exits chosen by it the way the others' are by distToHeart. The cost is the Reeds' solver: two small Reeds are ~5 ms a frame at 240 Hz on this machine before the family's budget slows them; measure on the owner's machine with ?creatures=reed:small&ramp=1&fps=1 before choosing the count. The small Nih-Dairia is the huge tier at 240 Hz always: one at a time at most. (12) The rule asked for is the crowd cap's; what to investigate is the pulse sectors (their breath ignores the cap) and the threshold (the cap slows at 28 fps, the owner says 30). (13) A real slope is a terrain change: the walkable surface, the hull's drive and the bodies' planes all take the ground as the sphere; the crater's cone would need a height field under the hull (and the fall, a state). Design first.
evidence: src/fx/creature-reed.js (the family, its budget), src/content/creature-enemies.js (CREATURE_TIERS.reed, CREATURE_FAMILY.budget), src/content/sectors.js CROWD_CAP, src/fx/crowd-gate.js, src/domain/sector-shape.js flowTarget, src/sinkhole.js, src/game-breaches.js craters
